scripts.title: teamhahaha10 gui v1
scripts.script:
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local guiParent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local assets = {
	background = "123925201141701",
	buttonImage = "99732973978252",
	jumpscareSound = "6129291390"
}

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "Delta_GUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = guiParent

local bg = Instance.new("ImageLabel", gui)
bg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 600, 0, 600)
bg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -300, 0.5, -300)
bg.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. assets.background
bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0
bg.BorderSizePixel = 4
bg.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
bg.Active = true
bg.Draggable = true

-- Üst Başlık
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "teamhahaha10 GUI"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
title.TextScaled = true

-- R6 ve R15 Butonları (küçük)
local function createRigButton(text, rigType, position)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", bg)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 30)
	btn.Position = position
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextScaled = true
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		game:GetService("Players"):SetCharacterAppearanceAsync(player.UserId, rigType)
	end)
end

createRigButton("R6", Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6, UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 5))
createRigButton("R15", Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15, UDim2.new(1, -45, 0, 5))

-- Fonksiyonlar ve input alanı
local inputs = {}

local function createImageButton(parent, text, pos, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("ImageButton", parent)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 40)
	btn.Position = pos
	btn.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. assets.buttonImage
	btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextScaled = true

	if callback then
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
	end
end

local function createInput(name, pos)
	local input = Instance.new("TextBox", bg)
	input.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 30)
	input.Position = pos
	input.PlaceholderText = name .. " ID gir"
	input.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	input.TextScaled = true
	input.Text = ""
	input.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	input.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
	input.BorderSizePixel = 0
	inputs[name] = input
end

-- Uygulama Fonksiyonları
local function applyDecal()
	local id = inputs["decal"].Text
	if tonumber(id) then
		for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				for _, face in pairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
					local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
					decal.Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. id
					decal.Face = face
					decal.Parent = part
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function applySkybox()
	local id = inputs["skybox"].Text
	if tonumber(id) then
		for _, obj in pairs(game.Lighting:GetChildren()) do
			if obj:IsA("Sky") then obj:Destroy() end
		end
		local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
		for _, face in {"Bk", "Dn", "Ft", "Lf", "Rt", "Up"} do
			sky["Skybox" .. face] = "rbxassetid://" .. id
		end
		sky.Parent = game.Lighting
	end
end

local function applyMusic()
	local id = inputs["music"].Text
	if tonumber(id) then
		local sound = Instance.new("Sound", workspace)
		sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
		sound.Volume = 1
		sound.Looped = true
		sound:Play()
	end
end

local function applyParticles()
	local id = inputs["particles"].Text
	if tonumber(id) then
		for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", part)
				p.Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. id
				p.Rate = 30
				p.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2)
				p.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function applyJumpscare()
	local id = inputs["jumpscare"].Text
	if tonumber(id) then
		local jumpscareGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", guiParent)
		local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel", jumpscareGui)
		image.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		image.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. id
		image.BackgroundTransparency = 1

		local sound = Instance.new("Sound", image)
		sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. assets.jumpscareSound
		sound.Volume = 10
		sound:Play()

		sound.Ended:Connect(function()
			jumpscareGui:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end

-- Sol Butonlar
local solButonlar = {
	"🎨 Decal", "🌌 Skybox", "🎵 Music", "✨ Particles", "😱 Jumpscare"
}
for i, text in ipairs(solButonlar) do
	createImageButton(bg, text, UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 60 + (i - 1) * 45), nil)
end

-- Sağ Butonlar ve inputlar
local sagButonlar = {
	{text = "🎨 Decal Ayarla", key = "decal", func = applyDecal},
	{text = "🌌 Skybox Ayarla", key = "skybox", func = applySkybox},
	{text = "🎵 Music Ayarla", key = "music", func = applyMusic},
	{text = "✨ Particles Ayarla", key = "particles", func = applyParticles},
	{text = "😱 Jumpscare Ayarla", key = "jumpscare", func = applyJumpscare}
}
for i, data in ipairs(sagButonlar) do
	local y = 60 + (i - 1) * 75
	createInput(data.key, UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, y))
	createImageButton(bg, data.text, UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, y + 35), data.func)
end

-- TP Butonları
local function createTeleportButton(text, pos, placeId)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", bg)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
	btn.Position = pos
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	btn.TextScaled = true
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(placeId, player)

local function createRotatingImage(side)
	local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	image.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100)
	image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	image.Image = "rbxassetid://123925201141701"
	image.Parent = bg  -- Artık bg'nin içinde, bg ile birlikte hareket eder

	if side == "left" then
		image.Position = UDim2.new(0, -110, 0.5, -50) -- GUI'nin sol dışına
	elseif side == "right" then
		image.Position = UDim2.new(1, 10, 0.5, -50) -- GUI'nin sağ dışına
	end

	local rotation = 0
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			rotation = (rotation + 2) % 360
			image.Rotation = rotation
			task.wait(0.01)
		end
	end)
end

-- Sol ve Sağ yanlara dönen büyük kare ekle (bg ile birlikte hareket eder)
createRotatingImage("left")
createRotatingImage("right")

scripts.title: SkidUILibrary
scripts.script:
local url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/randomuser832/R22222222222222/refs/heads/main/SkidzUiLib.lua"

local SkidzWare
local success, err = pcall(function()
    local source = game:HttpGet(url)
    SkidzWare = loadstring(source)()
end)


if not success then
    warn("Failed to load SkidzWare UI Library: "..tostring(err))
    return
end


local tab1 = SkidzWare:CreateTab("Main")
local tab2 = SkidzWare:CreateTab("Settings")

-- Add Button
tab1.CreateButton("Click Me!", function()
    print("Button clicked!")
    SkidzWare.Notify("Button Clicked!",3)
end)

tab1.CreateToggle("Enable Feature", function(state)
    print("Toggle is now:", state)
end)


-- Add Textbox
tab1.CreateTextbox("Type here...", function(text)
    print("Textbox input:", text)
    SkidzWare.Notify("You typed: "..text,2)
end)

-- Add Slider
tab1.CreateSlider("Volume",0,100,function(val)
    print("Slider value:", math.floor(val))
end)

-- Keybind setup for menu toggle
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local menuKey = Enum.KeyCode.Insert -- default key

-- Special key name mappings
local specialKeys = {
    ["rightshift"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
    ["leftshift"]  = Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift,
    ["space"]      = Enum.KeyCode.Space,
    ["tab"]        = Enum.KeyCode.Tab,
    ["enter"]      = Enum.KeyCode.Return,
    ["escape"]     = Enum.KeyCode.Escape,
    ["capslock"]   = Enum.KeyCode.CapsLock,
    ["leftalt"]    = Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt,
    ["rightalt"]   = Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt,
    ["leftcontrol"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl,
    ["rightcontrol"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl
}


tab2.CreateTextbox("Enter key to toggle menu (e.g., R, F, Insert, RightShift)", function(text)
    local keyName = text:lower() -- normalize to lowercase
    local key = specialKeys[keyName]

    -- In your keybind textbox handler:
if key then
    menuKey = key
    SkidzWare.Notify("Menu toggle key set to: "..tostring(key), 2)
else
    -- Fallback: check if it's a valid UserInputType
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return Enum.UserInputType[keyName:upper()]
    end)
    if success and result then
        menuKey = result
        SkidzWare.Notify("Menu toggle key set to: "..tostring(result), 2)
    else
        SkidzWare.Notify("Invalid key: "..text, 2)
    end
end
end)
-- Detect key press to toggle menu
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then return end -- ignore if typing in TextBox
    if input.KeyCode == menuKey then
        local mainFrame = SkidzWare.MainFrame or game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("SkidzWare"):FindFirstChild("MainFrame")
        if mainFrame then
            mainFrame.Visible = not mainFrame.Visible
            SkidzWare.Notify("Menu "..(mainFrame.Visible and "Shown" or "Hidden"), 2)
        end
    end
end)

-- Notifications test
SkidzWare.Notify("UI Loaded Successfully!",3)

-- Test multiple notifications
task.delay(1,function() SkidzWare.Notify("Second Notification!",3) end)
task.delay(2,function() SkidzWare.Notify("Third Notification!",3) end)
scripts.features:
🔹 UI Framework (SkidzWare)

Custom UI library 

Provides helpers:

CreateTab(name) → make new UI sections.

CreateButton(label, callback) → clickable buttons.

CreateToggle(label, callback) → on/off switches.

CreateTextbox(placeholder, callback) → input fields.

CreateSlider(label, min, max, callback) → adjustable sliders.

Notify(message, duration) → clean notification popups.

Includes main draggable window with topbar.

Has a loading screen with progress bar (time adjustable inside the lib).

🔹 Tabs & Layout

Two tabs by default:

Main tab (buttons, toggle, textbox, slider).

Settings tab (menu toggle keybind).

Tabs are switchable within the UI.

🔹 Main Tab Features

Button → click logs to console + shows notification.

Toggle → switch on/off, logs state + shows notification.

Textbox →

User can type input.

Box shrunk to ~30% width for a cleaner look.

Logs typed text + shows notification.

Slider →

Range 0 → 100.

Label text sits above the slider (no overlap).

Adjusting logs value to console.

🔹 Menu Toggle (Keybind System)

Menu visibility can be toggled on/off with a key press.

User sets the key through a textbox in the Settings tab.

Features of keybind system:

Accepts both lowercase & uppercase letters (e.g., r or R).

Supports special keys:

rightshift, leftshift, space, tab, enter, escape, capslock, ctrl, alt.
(cant be in shiftlock mode for it working on it)

On key press → toggles menu visibility + shows notification.

🔹 Notifications System

Built-in popup messages (SkidzWare.Notify).

Used for:

Confirming button clicks.

Toggle state changes.

Textbox submissions.

Slider adjustments.

Keybind set success/failure.

Menu show/hide events.

🔹 Expandability

Easy to add new UI elements:

More tabs (e.g., "ESP", "Aimbot", "Fun").

More buttons, toggles, sliders, textboxes.

Everything stays clean and consistent with the SkidzWare style.

👉 In short:

scripts.script:
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")

local CloseButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.8, 0)

Frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Draggable = true


ActivateButton.Parent = Frame
ActivateButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ActivateButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.7, 0)
ActivateButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
ActivateButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ActivateButton.Text = "Activate"
ActivateButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ActivateButton.TextScaled = true


CloseButton.Parent = Frame
CloseButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)
CloseButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.3, 0)
CloseButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.7, 0)
CloseButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
CloseButton.Text = "Close GUI"
CloseButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseButton.TextScaled = true


spawn(function()
	while true do
		Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(0,255), math.random(0,255), math.random(0,255))
		wait(0.2)
	end
end)


local active = false
local teleporting = false


local positions = {
	Vector3.new(0, 10, 0),
	Vector3.new(10, 10, 10),
	Vector3.new(-10, 10, -10),
	Vector3.new(10, 10, -10),
	Vector3.new(-10, 10, 10)
}


ActivateButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	active = not active
	ActivateButton.Text = active and "Deactivate" or "Activate"

	if active and not teleporting then
		local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end

		teleporting = true
		local delayTime = 2
		local minDelay = 0.2
		local step = 0.1

		spawn(function()
			while teleporting and hrp and hrp.Parent do
				local pos = positions[math.random(1, #positions)]
				hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
				wait(delayTime)
				delayTime = math.max(minDelay, delayTime - step)
			end
		end)
	else
		teleporting = false
	end
end)


CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	teleporting = false
	ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)
